description: This Java source file defines the EtbResearch class, which provides UI and logic for conducting Electronic Throttle Body (ETB) research/testing through a button interface. It manages ETB duty cycle adjustments via commands sent to hardware, monitors sensor feedback, and maintains internal state throughout the process.

classes.name: EtbResearch
classes.description: Main class managing the ETB research process, UI button, and related logic.

classes.name: State
classes.description: Enumerates the different states of the ETB research process, including DEBUG_MODE, START, GOING_UP, and GOING_DOWN.

methods.name: EtbResearch
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the button and its action listener for starting ETB research.

methods.name: getButton
methods.description: Returns the JButton component that triggers the ETB research process.

methods.name: sleep
methods.description: Pauses execution for a specified period, logging the sleep duration.

methods.name: resetValues
methods.description: Resets internal ETB duty cycle related variables to initial states.
